title: NUMISHEET profile-contact diagnostic: 25.3 mm isotropic J2 run
status: completed diagnostic; not a valid benchmark comparison

provenance.resume_path: local scikit-fem-native source with non-contact punch-withdrawal fast path

puso_reference_condition_checks.reference_angle_measurement_definition: Puso Table 2 reports the outside flange angle after springback as the flange deflection from horizontal.
puso_reference_condition_checks.model_angle_measurement_definition: absolute line-fit angle of outer midplane flange nodes from global horizontal

punch_force_stroke.reason: The reference input requests punch RF/U history, but its output database and an independent force-stroke curve are not included locally. The model curve is exported in punch_force_by_stroke.

published_numerical_prediction.source: F. Pourboghrat and E. Chu, Prediction of spring-back and side-wall curl in 2-D draw bending, Journal of Materials Processing Technology 50 (1995), Table 3
published_numerical_prediction.comparison_scope: The article identifies this as the NUMISHEET benchmark channel with 5 mm punch/die radii, 350 mm by 35 mm blank, 70 mm travel, friction coefficient 0.144, and 0.78 mm initial thickness. These ABAQUS thickness predictions are a same-process numerical comparator, but its reported hardening parameters differ from the Burchitz Appendix A.3 values above and must not be labeled an exact same-material validation.

thickness.reason: A published ABAQUS table gives punch, die, and wall-region thickness predictions for the 19.6 kN process, but its material differs from canonical B3 and its region labels are not mapped to this model's x-profile. The local data contain no measured post-forming thickness profile. Model profiles are reported for formed and springback states.

published_puso_isotropic_result.source: M. Puso, A Users Manual for the Nonlinear Kinematic Hardening Model for Cyclic Loading, UCRL-MA-140587, 2000, Table 1
published_puso_isotropic_result.published_formulation_status: not documented well enough for a formulation match
published_puso_isotropic_result.interpretation: The Puso 17.20 degree result is a direct process/material comparator when the Puso law, 2.45 kN holder load, and 0.144 friction are selected. This solid-element run is still not an exact reproduction because the published element/contact formulation is not established as matching.

springback_angle.reason: The 17.1 degree experiment is a valid target only for a converged full-stroke run matching the Puso material, 2.45 kN holder load, and 0.144 friction; inspect the Puso-specific condition checks for unmet conditions.
